text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "—*gasp*... *wheeze*...! *cough*...!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
......Incredible... ...To think she's 
grown this much...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I knew it... Someone like me can't...!

text_block_list.name: Stream Comment
text_block_list.text: "—Amazing! That was an incredible race!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ! Is this... everyone's... voices...?

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey! That race just now was amazing, 
wasn't it!? Felt like both <chrname> and Kiseki 
gave it everything they had!"

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: Yeah—yup! My heart is still racing...!

text_block_list.name: Stream Comment
text_block_list.text:
“――Wooooah! That was so moving!” “――I 
can't wait for the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe!” “――Take on the world and 
win!!!”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Aah! Amazing... To think it could 
generate this much heat...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I see. The one who created this 
frenzy... was partly me, too.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm also a part of this production... So 
that means I have a role to play, too—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Then... I...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> claimed a splendid victory in the 
Representative Exchange Race. The joy and 
excitement of it showed no signs of 
fading.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That was a wonderful race, Trainer-san! It 
felt like a true clash of titans!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If this were a shonen manga serialization, 
I'd definitely take #1 in the popularity 
poll! Maybe even get the center color 
spread!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Your running was amazing, too.
Yeah! Your run was amazing too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thank you very much! ...But, I've 
made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I decline the nomination as 
representative. I will not run in the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I've realized it. The one who creates a 
thrilling story in the upcoming Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe... isn't going to be me.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm sure it's all of you.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So, my role is as an assistant... I'll 
support all of you with everything I've 
got!
choice_data_list:
Still, whether we'll be chosen as 
representatives is...

Still, whether we'll be chosen as the 
representatives...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"No! I'm absolutely certain of it! You ran 
such an incredible race! You two will 
definitely be chosen!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"So please, hold your heads high! You are 
the stars of the show!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's the spirit! Listen up, if you 
put on a pathetic run, I will never 
forgive you, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Because you're everyone's hope! No matter 
how strong the rival... you face... If 
it's you... guys—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: …………Huh, wait...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if bewildered, she wiped at her eyes. 
Almost as if trying to hide whatever was 
welling up in them.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha. Guess it really is no good... 
...Um. Just please let me make one 
declaration.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —*Inhaaaale*... *Exhaaale*...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: My story doesn't end here--!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No matter how covered in mud you get! It's 
digging deep and standing right back up 
that makes you the protagonist! That's 
why... that's whyâ!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to create a work way more 
interesting than yours!! No matter what!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe! Yeah, I feel refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'm expecting a masterpiece... 
one that'll drive everyone wild and burn 
itself into their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Because you guys are my rivals!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Representative Exchange Race came to 
an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, summoned by Mei Satake, the 
members of "Project L'Arc" stood lined up 
in formation.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Now, I will announce the Umamusume chosen 
to represent us. ...However, there is 
something I must tell you beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki declines the offer to represent 
Japan. However, she promised to do 
everything she could to help everyone 
challenging the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Carrying the hopes of Kiseki, and everyone 
who supports me... on my shoulders... I'm 
going to win the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Now, I will read out the names of the 
Umamusume selected to represent us. The 
first is—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: <chrname>！

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —At that moment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My eyes met Kiseki's. She gazed intently 
at me and <chrname>—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She entrusted everything to us.
